Guy moved in next door a while back. I've waved at him twice and never got his name.
Now Maddie's over there till midnight most nights. She's seventeen. He's a grown man.
What's his name?

So she knows him better than I do.
She walks in after midnight smelling like an oven. Bread, garlic, something sweet.
This is a kid who burned toast twice in one week last year.
What is she actually doing over there every night?

That's more than I'd have guessed.
But she hasn't bought a thing all summer. Same sneakers, same cracked phone case.
Who is she sending all that money to?

Oh no. They hold our mortgage.
Celia's handled the bills for twenty years. I never once checked behind her. 😳
My kid has been covering for us.
How much are we behind on the mortgage?

I feel sick. 💔
I've been fixing other people's furnaces while my own house was going under.
If she's paying them, she's had to talk to somebody over there.
Who has she been dealing with at the lender?

She's been making grown-up phone calls behind my back. Polite ones, I bet.
Celia comes home every night saying work's been brutal. Kicks off her shoes and that's it.
What did Maddie find out about her mom's job?

She sat there all day with her lunch so I wouldn't find out.
And her car's been next door late at night too. I've seen it twice on my way to bed.
What is Celia doing for Theo?
